stepAnswer: A to U, T to A, G to C, C to G
stepExplanation: During transcription, DNA bases pair with RNA bases: Adenine (A) pairs with Uracil (U), Thymine (T) pairs with Adenine (A), Guanine (G) pairs with Cytosine (C), and Cytosine (C) pairs with Guanine (G).
stepBody: In transcription, RNA polymerase reads the DNA template strand and creates a complementary mRNA. What RNA base pairs with each DNA base? (Remember: RNA has Uracil instead of Thymine)
